info.name: AI SDR SaaS
info.description:
Complete API collection for the AI SDR SaaS backend (NestJS), generated directly from the controller/DTO source and Prisma schema on 2026-08-18. Every response is wrapped by a global TransformInterceptor as { success: true, data, timestamp }; every error follows AllExceptionsFilter's { statusCode, message, error, timestamp, path, requestId } shape. Auth is a global JwtAuthGuard (Bearer {{accessToken}}) + RolesGuard (@Roles(OWNER|ADMIN|MEMBER)) -- every route requires a token unless explicitly marked @Public() (auth endpoints, health endpoints, and all provider webhooks). See postman/README.md for setup, run order, and known limitations.

Total requests in this collection: 232.

item.description: IMPORTANT LIMITATION: this backend has no Users/Organizations controller at all -- there is no invite-user or create-member API. Every /auth/register call creates a brand-new organization with the registering user as OWNER; there is no way to provision a MEMBER-role user in an EXISTING org through the HTTP API. To exercise true MEMBER-forbidden behavior (403 from RolesGuard), seed a second User row with role=MEMBER directly in the database for the same organizationId as {{organizationId}}, log in as that user, and set the result as {{memberAccessToken}} -- then re-run any OWNER/ADMIN-only request (e.g. "Leads > Assign Lead", "Campaigns > Start Campaign") with Authorization overridden to Bearer {{memberAccessToken}} and expect 403. This is documented here rather than faked with an invented endpoint.
